findings.issue: The output sink PATH was correctly unified to `work/api-scraper/logs/working/task-7/audit-report.md` (Reviewers line 168), but residual wording from the pre-fix `.json` state still describes it as a JSON sink: line 32 ("the per-finding JSON sink described below"), line 68 ("Write the report to the JSON sink path (see Reviewers)"), line 84 AC ("Audit report written to the JSON sink"), line 170 Reviewers (prescribes a per-finding JSON object schema `{ "severity": ..., "issue": ..., "location": ..., "fix": ... }`), and line 174 Post-completion ("ссылка на JSON-отчёт аудита"). The deliverable format (.md report) now contradicts the 'JSON sink' prose. Tasks 8 and 9 consistently describe a Markdown audit report.
findings.fix: Align Task 7 wording with the unified .md sink: replace 'JSON sink' with 'audit report' (lines 32, 68, 84); convert the JSON per-finding schema in the Reviewers section (line 170) to describe Markdown finding entries (severity / location file:symbol / issue / fix); change 'ссылка на JSON-отчёт аудита' to 'ссылка на logs/working/task-7/audit-report.md' (line 174). Mirror the phrasing already used in Tasks 8 and 9.

notes: The iteration-1 divergence (task 7 .json, task 8 security-audit.md, task 9 logs/audits/test-audit.md) is RESOLVED — all three now point at logs/working/task-{N}/audit-report.md.
Only regression-adjacent residue is the stale 'JSON' vocabulary inside task 7's prose and its per-finding object schema (minor). No other regressions introduced.

Standard skills<->reviewers mapping (code-writing->reviewers, skill-master->skill-checker) does not apply: these are analysis-only audit tasks with reviewers:[] by design (the auditor is itself the review artifact).
